rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Direxion Daily INTC Bull 2X Shares
positions.sector: Technology — Semiconductors (2x Leveraged Single-Stock ETF, long INTC)
positions.catalyst: Intel blew out Q2 after the close on 7/23: adjusted EPS 38c vs 24c est, and guided Q3 revenue to $15.8-16.8B vs $15.01B consensus — concrete evidence the foundry turnaround under Lip-Bu Tan is gaining traction. Analysts have been marking up PTs into the print (KeyBanc Overweight to $155, UBS to $121). INTC is trading ~+2.9% pre-market at $103.17 (live, asOf 2026-07-24T11:42Z) after tagging ~+5.5% earlier — a digestible, un-blown-out gap on a genuine fundamental beat, not a squeeze.
positions.driver: Long 2x INTC via LINT as a single-name, one-sided earnings-momentum play. 2x matches HIGH conviction on a strong FRESH catalyst (blowout beat + raised guide + PT hikes + turnaround narrative). Chose LINT over INTC common for torque, and over INTW (same 2x exposure, LINT more standard/liquid). Entered UNEXTENDED: LINT ~+6.8% pre-market (132.95 vs 124.24 close), well under the 8-10% chase line, because the underlying INTC gap cooled from +5.5% to +2.9% by run time. Crypto skipped (BTC/ETH choppy near lows, no edge, and equity hours favor leveraged instruments). Prior GUSH energy trade closed — crude spike reversed overnight, thesis broke. Hard stop 122.31 (-8% on 2x).
positions.risks: Single-stock earnings pops frequently fade intraday ('sell-the-news') once the gap is faded, and 2x amplifies both directions plus carries daily-reset decay if INTC chops. A broad risk-off tape or a semis-wide pullback could drag INTC regardless of its beat. Guidance-driven rallies can round-trip if the conference-call tone disappoints. Hard stop 122.31 (-8%). PRICE NOTE: dashboard proxy was STALE for both legs (showed prior closes — GUSH 39.51, LINT 124.24 — Yahoo not reflecting pre-market on these leveraged ETFs), so per rules used Robinhood real-time: GUSH SELL struck 39.08 (live bid 11:40Z); LINT BUY struck 132.95 (live ask, bid/ask 132.50/132.95 at 11:42Z, assume LIMIT).
